Tiranga Yatras Held Across India Emphasizing Unity and Patriotism

Multiple Tiranga Yatras, or flag marches, were organized across various Indian cities, including Kawardha, Hansi, Palwal, and Bhopal. In Kawardha, a 354-foot national flag was displayed, while in Hansi, students carried a 500-foot flag and formed a human chain to promote unity. Palwal saw a 5km Tiranga Yatra led by Sports Minister Gaurav Gautam, and Bhopal hosted a historic yatra flagged off by Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, covering 32km. These events aimed to showcase patriotism and national unity.
